newsitem.title: FRANCE: Zodiac sees double-digit growth for 96/97.
newsitem.headline: Zodiac sees double-digit growth for 96/97.

text.p: Civil aeronautics group Zodiac expects double-digit growth in sales and earnings for the year to September 30, 1997, the company said on Friday.
"The group expects double-digit growth," it said in a statement issued at a news conference. A spokesman said the forecast referred to both sales and earnings.
The company said its civil aeronautics branch would lead the rise with gains of around 15 percent, while the leisure water sports business would grow but at a more moderate pace.
For the year ended September 30, 1996, Zodiac had net attributable profit of 174.1 million francs, up 15.2 percent.
It had sales of 3.4 billion for the 1995/96 year, up 12.5 percent from the previous year.
